args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; [Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); Import-Module PSScriptAnalyzer -MinimumVersion 1.25.0; $request = ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable -InputObject ([Console]::In.ReadToEnd()); ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -InputObject @(Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -ScriptDefinition $request.source -Settings $request.config | Select-Object RuleName, Message, Severity, Extent, SuggestedCorrections)
